changelog: Initial public release. End-to-end setup for Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) targeted at SMBs in Argentina and LATAM. Fully updated to Meta's per-message pricing model (July 2025). Includes 6 HSM templates in Argentine Spanish (appointments, reminders, payments, ARCA deadlines, order pickup, onboarding), Graph API v23.0 curl examples, opt-in compliance, 24-hour service window rules, Free Entry Points (72h CTWA window), messaging tiers, and anti-ban checklist. Strict Meta-official-API-only policy — no Baileys, no third-party BSPs.
summary: Configuración completa de WhatsApp Business API (oficial Meta) para PyMEs de Argentina y LATAM. Actívate cuando el usuario mencione: WhatsApp Business, WA AP...
